text:
devon: heads-up — eu-west1 tiny-gpu pool is piling up pending pods, lots of lease-holder nodes labeled elder-shard. looks like leasing is preventing compact packing and triggering preempt churn.
ash: can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` for a representative job?
devon: sure, pasted output below
```text
NAME                           READY STATUS    NODE
train-tiny-abc                 0/1   Pending   <none>
embed-worker-small-xyz         0/1   Pending   <none>
service-runner-small-1        0/1   Pending   <none>
``` 
maria: scheduler logs show repeated bind failures: "no nodes match pod's nodeSelector or tolerations" and "node has taint: elder-shard=true:NoSchedule"
shay: is elder-shard a static reserve for committed capacity? we've seen this before when old reservation TTLs expire slowly
devon: yeah, it's a soft-reserve policy for Dedicated pools. TTLs are long and warmpool refill is slow because quota is at cap in eu-west1.
ash: quick mitigation idea: temporary relax elder-shard taint to NoSchedule->PreferNoSchedule equivalent or add a nodeSelector override for tiny pods so they can pack ephemeral shards
maria: plus we should tune lease reclaim window. current lease reclaim is 120s and preemption happens immediately causing thrash.
shay: can we also adjust the autoscaler to prioritize warmpool fill on sustained pending tiny pods? right now it throttles because of AZ quota skew
devon: created INC-2026-0421 and assigned to infra oncall. putting telemetry here: logs + kube events show surge started ~6135678800
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 created and page sent to @infra-oncall
ash: action items: 1) short-term: relax taint on 2 elder nodes in eu-west1 (devon) 2) change lease reclaim to 30s window for tiny-gpu class (maria) 3) autoscaler weight bump for warmpools (shay) 4) file RFC for compaction-group that can pull legacy reserves into a compactable cohort (devon)
maria: I can make the lease reclaim change, but will monitor CPU/retention. rolling change across azs will be gradual.
devon: I'll relax taints now on elder-eu-west1-a and elder-eu-west1-b and report if pending drops
shay: TY. please post results in this thread and I'll follow up with an ops runbook update
devon: quick update: relaxed taints on elder-eu-west1-a, pending count dropped from 22 -> 6 in ~120s. looks promising :thumbsup:
ash: nice. schedule a short retro tomorrow to lock permanent fixes.
maria: RFC link: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/compaction-cohort-2026 (poked infra chairs)
devon: assigning follow-ups in Jira: RW-OPS-1123 RW-OPS-1124
shay: closing loop once autoscaler tweak rolled. thanks team :rocket:
